parsed.why: No trans-specific criminalisation and a border programme easing mismatched passports, plus reported social acceptance. But custody often places trans women by birth sex and a hospital ward refusal is documented; no hate-crime recourse.

Active morality-law enforcement targets trans women; documented sweeps, arrests, forced anal exams, beatings and birth-sex prison processing. No protective machinery or working remedy for an outed visitor.

No trans-specific criminalisation, but documented border mocking, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection, censorship of expression and no recourse; institutional climate hostile though violence is not documented as patterned.

No same-sex criminalisation, but police blackmail of LGBTQ people, anti-propaganda law, removed legal recognition, rising hostile rhetoric and attacks; no protection machinery. Draft anti-trans law is not yet in force.

Constitutional gender-identity protection, marriage equality, legal gender change, state-backed trans programme and no current police targeting. Old police campaigns are dated; remaining gaps are resident-facing or unresolved rather than traveller exposure.
